title.zh: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
title.en: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever

current_state.zh: Zcash's upcoming NU7 upgrade will invalidate v4 transactions and render roughly 12,224 ZEC (about $15–16 million) still sitting in the legacy Sprout privacy pool permanently unspendable unless holders move them before activation, while also tripling confirmation speed and retiring outdated network technology.
